title: Banach–Steinhaus bound for weakly bounded sequences of locally integrable functions
statement: Let P, Q ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on (the Borel σ-algebra of) ℝ^P, and let g_k : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (k ∈ ℕ) be locally μ-integrable. Assume that for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ there is C_f with ‖∫ f g_k dμ‖ ≤ C_f for all k. Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P there is a real M such that ‖∫ h g_k dμ‖ ≤ M·C for every k ∈ ℕ, every continuous h : ℝ^P → ℝ with h = 0 outside K, and every real C with |h(x)| ≤ C for all x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μ) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∃ C, ∀ k, ‖∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μ‖ ≤ C) → IsCompact K → ∃ M, ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Continuous h → (∀ x ∉ K, h x = 0) → (∀ x, |h x| ≤ C) → ‖∫ x, h x • gs k x ∂μ‖ ≤ M * C
